scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Asian drama, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: V12 lightweight TMDB hotfix: provider startup now requests only core TMDB metadata (title, original title, year). Heavy alternative_titles/translations are no longer appended to the mandatory first request, preventing slow mobile TMDB responses from blocking all source extraction. Existing fuzzy/original-title matching and provider-specific fallbacks remain.
